task_text: I need to do the dishes in 15 minutes. Clean up the kitchen and bring back anything that belongs there.

central_instructions.R1: Assist with dishwashing tasks in the kitchen by handling light objects and passing them to R2.
central_instructions.R2: Navigate the kitchen to collect and pass light objects to other rooms as needed.
central_instructions.R3: Assist with any light object tasks in the living room and pass them to R4.
central_instructions.R4: Navigate the living room to collect and pass light objects to other rooms as needed.
central_instructions.R5: Assist with any light object tasks in the bedroom and pass them to R6.
central_instructions.R6: Navigate the bedroom to collect and pass both light and heavy objects to other rooms as needed.
central_instructions.R7: Assist with any light object tasks in the bathroom and pass them to R8.
central_instructions.R8: Navigate the bathroom to collect and pass both light and heavy objects to other rooms as needed.
